result.fix: Read them with `ausearch -m avc -ts yesterday`. Install the vendor policy module, or label the volume with `chcon -Rt container_file_t <volume path>` or the `:Z` mount option. The `chcon` label does not survive a relabel. Ask the vendor for the persistent rule. Last resort: run `setenforce 0` now and set `SELINUX=permissive` in `/etc/selinux/config`. This turns SELinux protection off, so ask the security team first.
result.message: SELinux is enforcing and denied 3 actions in the last 24h for container_t.
notes: 1 of the denials were logged in permissive mode, so they were not blocked.
